For Nodding flower campion (Silene nutans), here are the environmental parameters:

• Temperature: 15-20°C
• Hydrometry: 40-60%
• Sunshine: 6-8 hours
• Rainfall: 500-700 mm
• Humidity: 50-70%
• Soil type: Limestone, well-drained
• Climate: Temperate
• Water level: Low-moderate
• Suitable location: Central Europe

Specific regions/countries:
• Germany
• Czech Republic
• Austria
• Poland
• United Kingdom

Note: These parameters are generalized and can vary slightly depending on specific microclimate conditions. The Nodding flower campion is adaptable and can tolerate diverse conditions within these ranges.
